purpose: Original-video adjacent-frame evidence for later Cocos motion/animation validation

source.decoder: installed Chrome HTML5 video decoder via local byte-range server
source.note: Requested media times are exact; the decoder displays the nearest encoded video frame.

heuristics.tracking: anchor at matched t12/t18 coordinate, then propagate independently backward and forward by 102 ms
heuristics.occlusionPolicy: boundary hits or template MAE above threshold are retained but excluded from position conclusions; low runner-up margin also excludes sprite-phase conclusions
